C0756.title: Bengbu Huaiyuan Teacher Training School Website Hacked Due to Inadequate Cybersecurity Level Protection Compliance
C0756.summary: On August 12, 2017, the website of Huaiyuan County Teacher Training School in Bengbu was hacked due to inadequate implementation of cybersecurity protection and the Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS).
